name: symbiote-3x
description: Machine-readable Symbiote.js 3.x rules for reusable package, UI, and provider contracts.

rules.name: triple-file-standard
rules.description: Production components are split into .js, .tpl.js, and .css.js files.

rules.name: no-inline-templates
rules.description: Templates are defined in .tpl.js files instead of inline component bodies.

rules.name: css-token-usage
rules.description: Component CSS uses --sn-* custom properties for themeable values.

rules.name: node-safe-core
rules.description: Root, core, manifest, rules, schemas, and tokens remain importable without DOM globals.

rules.name: single-binding-block
rules.description: Each template element has at most one Symbiote binding block.

rules.name: published-library-contract
rules.description: Public metadata, rules, schemas, and token files are reachable from package exports and files[].

rules.name: agent-boundary
rules.description: Agent-facing manifests describe modules and rules without importing browser components.

rules.name: public-subpath-imports
rules.description: Consumers import symbiote-node through package exports instead of relative package internals or deep implementation paths.
